ANALYZE.description: Read DAE.md plan, locate target files, enumerate hw/unittest/ to identify the unit test directory that exercises VX_gemm_job_frontend, identify the kernel header file where GEMM_STREAM_ADDR_i and stream_send_burst will live, and establish baseline cycle count + MMIO gap distribution. Baseline run from build dir: 'make -C sim clean && make -C runtime clean && python ../ci/run_black.py xrt-vcs-sim --app=fpint_gemm_ffn_hw_improve --args="-m 512 -k 128 -n 128" --perf=3'. CONFIGS env var is set by .envrc/direnv — if missing, run 'direnv allow' once. Baseline gap analysis: tools/mmio_analysis/analyze_mmio_stall.py on the resulting FSDB.
checklist: Baseline cycle count from --perf=3 output recorded in STATUS.yaml
Baseline MMIO gap distribution captured from analyze_mmio_stall.py
Concrete unit test directory under hw/unittest/ that covers VX_gemm_job_frontend identified (or noted as missing — to be added in IMPL_BURST)
Kernel header file(s) where GEMM_STREAM_ADDR_i and stream_send_burst will be added identified (e.g. kernel/include/vx_intrinsics.h or a GEMM-specific header)
Files confirmed: tests/regression/fpint_gemm_ffn_hw_improve/kernel.cpp, hw/rtl/core/gemm/VX_gemm_job_frontend.sv, hw/rtl/core/gemm/VX_cmd_constructor.sv, hw/rtl/mem/VX_lmem_switch.sv

transitions.IMPL_DAE_SW: Baseline measured and target files identified

IMPL_DAE_SW.description: Implement Optimization 1 (helper-warp DAE, SW only) via the Implementer subagent. Place the SPSC ring + control words in local memory using the __local_mem(size) macro pattern (see tests/regression/conv3/kernel.cpp). Do NOT modify kernel/scripts/link64.ld — no new linker section is needed. Refactor kernel into run_producer / run_consumer / kernel_entry, initialize ring_head/ring_tail/producer_done in main() before vx_wspawn(2, &kernel_entry).
checklist: Ring + ring_head/ring_tail/producer_done addressed via __local_mem(LMEM_RESERVED_SIZE) at fixed byte offsets (canonical pattern: tests/regression/conv3/kernel.cpp)
kernel/scripts/link64.ld is NOT modified
kernel.cpp split into run_producer (uses ring_push) + run_consumer (uses stream_send) + kernel_entry dispatch
make_wait / make_notify words flow through ring_push (NOT direct stream_send) so order is preserved
main() initializes lmem_head/lmem_tail/lmem_done to 0 (with fence w,w) BEFORE vx_wspawn(2, &kernel_entry)
main() calls kernel_entry() on warp 0 after spawning warp 1
Clean build succeeds: 'make -C sim clean && make -C runtime clean' followed by full build

transitions.VERIFY_DAE_SW: Build clean and ring/wspawn wiring verified

VERIFY_DAE_SW.description: Run regression with helper-warp DAE. From build dir: 'make -C sim clean && make -C runtime clean && python ../ci/run_black.py xrt-vcs-sim --app=fpint_gemm_ffn_hw_improve --args="-m 512 -k 128 -n 128" --perf=3'. If CONFIGS missing, run 'direnv allow' once. **Pass criterion (RELAXED 2026-04-28 after iter2 analysis):** bit-identical output AND DAE engaged (active_warps == 0011) AND no fence-induced L2 flush regression (in-kernel fence executions < 100). DAE-alone cycle gate REMOVED — empirical analysis showed DAE-alone cannot beat baseline for this kernel because volatile-guarded ring_push/ring_pop add ~7-11 instrs/command vs only 1.5x IPC improvement. The cycle gain materializes only after IMPL_BURST (consumer amortizes MMIO over multiple words). This matches DAE.md §'Combined Approach' design intent.
checklist: Regression passes with bit-identical output vs. baseline
FSDB confirms active_warps == 0011 in dispatcher window (vs baseline 0001)
In-kernel fence count < 100 (no L2 flush flood); cycles recorded for later combined comparison

transitions.IMPL_BURST: Functional pass AND DAE engaged AND no fence flood (cycle gate deferred to VERIFY_COMBINED)
transitions.IMPL_DAE_SW: Functional fail OR DAE not engaged OR fence-induced regression

IMPL_BURST.description: Implement Optimization 2 RTL Option A AND its SW interface in parallel through the Implementer subagent. RTL: per-lane addr/data decode in VX_gemm_job_frontend.sv, mask-aware push of popcount(mask & is_stream_lane) words into a new 8-wide serializer FIFO (depth >= 16), serializer drains 1/cycle into existing constructor, req_ready reflects FIFO free slots. SW: GEMM_STREAM_ADDR_i (i=0..7, 8-byte stride at 0x1088) and stream_send_burst(words, k) using vx_tmc((1<<k)-1) + per-lane store. If the unit test for VX_gemm_job_frontend is missing or does not cover masked bursts, extend / create the testbench in this state too (Implementer is allowed). Re-verify compiler emit on both the prototype AND the production kernel.
checklist: VX_gemm_job_frontend.sv: addr decode replaced with per-lane (8 lanes)
Serializer FIFO instantiated (8-wide push, 1-wide pop, depth >= 16)
Mask-aware push pushes popcount(mask & is_stream_lane) words in lane-id order
req_ready holds until FIFO has room for popcount(mask) words
VX_cmd_constructor.sv unchanged (still 1 word/cycle)
GEMM_STREAM_ADDR_i constants defined for i=0..7 in the kernel header chosen in ANALYZE
stream_send_burst(const uint64_t words[8], int k) implemented
Prototype emit: 'make kernel.dump' in tests/regression/mmio_burst_proto/ produces single-sd bodies for case_burst8 and case_burst_partial
Production emit: stream_send_burst body in the production kernel disassembly is a single sd plus tmask setup (no strip-mined serial sd sequence)
Unit test for VX_gemm_job_frontend extended/created to cover mask=0xFF/0x0F/0x01 and FIFO near-full backpressure
Clean build succeeds

transitions.UNITTEST_BURST: Both RTL and SW build clean and compiler emit verified on prototype and production

UNITTEST_BURST.description: Run module-level unit tests for the modified RTL (the unit test directory identified/extended in IMPL_BURST). Per project policy, RTL changes must pass module unit tests before regression. If the testbench needs additional fixes, transition back to IMPL_BURST.
checklist: Module unit test passes with mask values 0xFF, 0x0F, and 0x01
FIFO near-full backpressure case (back-to-back 0xFF bursts to almost-full FIFO) passes without overflow
Serializer FIFO pushes popcount(mask) words per accepted handshake (waveform-checked)

transitions.IMPL_BURST: Module unit tests fail (RTL or testbench fix needed)

VERIFY_BURST.description: Run regression on the burst path (without DAE consumer integration yet). Same command as VERIFY_DAE_SW with --app=fpint_gemm_ffn_hw_improve. Confirm functional correctness end-to-end.
checklist: fpint_gemm_ffn_hw_improve regression produces bit-identical output vs. baseline
FSDB confirms gemm_ctrl_if[0]/req_data.mask matches SW vx_tmc(mask) (e.g., 0xFF / 0x0F)

COMBINE.description: SW-only step (via Implementer): modify the consumer warp from IMPL_DAE_SW to use stream_send_burst with k = min(8, ring_count). Consumer reads ring_count from LMEM head/tail, raises tmask, drains up to 8 ring words per warp instruction, then drops to vx_tmc_one to re-poll.
checklist: Consumer reads ring_count = (*lmem_head() - *lmem_tail()) and clamps k to min(8, ring_count)
Consumer calls stream_send_burst(local_words, k) then vx_tmc_one()
Producer warp unchanged (still single-thread)
Clean build succeeds

VERIFY_COMBINED.description: Run full regression with combined DAE + burst (same xrt-vcs-sim command, --app=fpint_gemm_ffn_hw_improve). Pass criterion: functional correctness AND end-to-end cycle count strictly less than baseline (positive speedup). This is the consolidated cycle gate for the whole task — DAE-only and burst-only intermediate states do NOT gate on cycles individually (per 2026-04-28 FSM relaxation; see VERIFY_DAE_SW description).
checklist: Regression passes with bit-identical output
End-to-end cycle count from --perf=3 recorded vs. baseline, DAE-only, and burst-only
Combined cycle count < baseline (positive end-to-end speedup)
STATUS.yaml completed_work updated with all four measurements (baseline / DAE-only / burst-only / combined)

transitions.DONE: Functional correct AND positive end-to-end speedup vs. baseline

DONE.description: Both optimizations implemented, verified, combined. Functional correctness confirmed and positive end-to-end speedup measured. Further performance tuning deferred to a follow-up task.
